items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Muggsy Spanier had the other band. We'd alternate there in Chicago.

ctx.x: Yeah, I don't remember that date but I know it was on -- it was after I left Chicago with that little band that Tommy Potter because I played in Chicago with my little band at the -- this all happened after I left Lunceford. I played in Chicago at the Capital Lounge, right next door to the Chicago Theater. That Had a little lounge right on the corner there. I had a band.

Muggsy Spanier had the other band. We'd alternate there in Chicago. And I took that band right from there to New York to 52nd Street to the Yacht Club. Chick Goldman had the Yacht Club then. And the other band alternated with me in there was Lips Page. Lips had a nice band in there, and Sandy Williams was playing trombone with him in that band.
